items.title: Live: World Cup 2026 gets underway at the Azteca
items.description: The 2026 FIFA World Cup gets underway at the Estadio Azteca in Mexico City, with the opening ceremony followed by the hosts, Mexico taking on South Africa in the opening game. Follow live.

items.title: Live: Trump cancels US strikes on Iran after threatening 'very hard' attack
items.description: The US president had said American forces were preparing to hit Iran "very hard". Follow live.

items.title: US forecasters say potentially record-breaking El Niño underway
items.description: There is a high chance this year's Pacific climate phenomenon will be among the strongest on record, which could lead to hotter temperatures across the globe.

items.title: Six Australian music acts inducted into ARIA Hall of Fame
items.description: Gurrumul, Jenny Morris, Kate Ceberano, Spiderbait, The Living End, and Vika and Linda Bull were elevated six to top-tier status at a ceremony in Sydney as part of ARIA's 40th anniversary celebrations.

items.title: Marles' AUKUS trip thrown into disarray as British defence secretary quits
items.description: Defence Minister Richard Marles's visit to the United Kingdom takes an awkward turn, after his British counterpart John Healey resigns hours before they were due to speak together.

items.title: Australians face a 'binary choice' as One Nation soars, says Chalmers
items.description: Treasurer Jim Chalmers hits out at Pauline Hanson's ties to Gina Rinehart and questions whether she actually stands for battling Australians.

items.title: 'Trying not to cry': Rabbitohs rise after emotional Jai Arrow moment
items.description: Jai Arrow has inspired South Sydney to a commanding win over the Brisbane Broncos, on an emotional night at Stadium Australia. Follow live.

items.title: Pauline Hanson reveals Gina Rinehart's role in One Nation policy making
items.description: Pauline Hanson speaks of her "respect" for billionaire Gina Rinehart , becoming emotional during a speech recalling her time in detention.

items.title: Hanson gets emotional revisiting decades-old Abbott feud
items.description: As Anthony Albanese stood in front of a Medicare banner and Pauline Hanson put her hand out for donations, voters could be forgiven for thinking the election was two months, not two years, away.

items.title: Melbourne aged care COVID outbreak back in spotlight
items.description: An inquest examining 50 COVID-era deaths at a Melbourne aged care home has resumed after a years-long hiatus.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
